# Syclops

> Syclops is referral management software for gyms, campuses, sales teams, fintech, medtech, and clinics in India. It records who sent each referral and what happened next, the field visits behind it, and membership plans and their payments, in one app.

Syclops is self-serve. Teams create a workspace with an email address and a business name, invite field staff, and add the people who refer. Referrers get a free login; only field seats are billed. Prices are per field seat per month in INR: Team ₹1,499, Growth ₹2,499, Scale ₹4,499. 14 days free, no card.

Crawling is welcome on every public page, including /login. /login is noindex and is not in the sitemap. See https://syclops.in/robots.txt and https://syclops.in/sitemap.xml.

## Product

- [Referral management software](https://syclops.in/referral-management-software): What the category covers, and how Syclops follows a referral from the person who sent it to what it became.
- [Referral product](https://syclops.in/product/referrals): Referrer logins, referral status from pending to arrived or the reason it stopped, conversions, and a duplicate check on mobile numbers.
- [Field tracking](https://syclops.in/product/field): GPS check-in with a photo stamped with the place and time, visit plans, routes, daily reports, and TA/DA.
- [TADA software](https://syclops.in/tada-software): TA/DA worked out from the distance travelled during the working day, using the allowance set for each distance range.
- [Gym referral software](https://syclops.in/gym-referral-software): Member referrals beside your gym software: who sent each new member, member logins, and memberships with a payment due.
- [Subscriptions](https://syclops.in/product/subscriptions): Membership plans sold from the phone, with Razorpay, cash and UPI payments, part payments in cash, and plans marked Payment Due.
- [Analytics](https://syclops.in/product/analytics): Partners never visited, partners visited but never referring, visits and attendance per person, and referrals by referrer and region, with Excel or PDF export.
- [Mobile app](https://syclops.in/product/mobile): Android app for field check-in, TA/DA, plan enrollment and referrals. Referrers can also use app.syclops.in in a browser.
- [Integrations](https://syclops.in/integrations): WhatsApp Business, Razorpay, Google Maps, and a hospital system (HIS) sync on Scale, scoped on a call.
- [Pricing](https://syclops.in/pricing): Per field seat per month. Referrer logins are not billed.
- [Security](https://syclops.in/security): Workspace isolation, role-based access, encryption, sign-in and change logs, and working-day GPS.

## Industries

- [Gyms](https://syclops.in/industries/gyms): Member referrals, trainer visits, and membership payments. See also [gym referral software](https://syclops.in/gym-referral-software).
- [Education](https://syclops.in/industries/education): Counselor visits, parent and alumni referrals, admissions, and fee payments that are due.
- [Sales and marketing](https://syclops.in/industries/sales): Sales visits, channel partner referrals, and conversions, beside your CRM. See also [channel partner login vs CRM source field](https://syclops.in/blog/channel-partner-portal-not-crm-source-field).
- [Fintech](https://syclops.in/industries/fintech): Agent visits, customer and DSA referrals, follow-up calls, and each policy or loan closed.
- [Medtech](https://syclops.in/industries/medtech): KOL visits, the introductions they lead to, follow-up calls, and each sale.
- [Healthcare](https://syclops.in/industries/healthcare): Referral doctors, PRO visits, and patient referrals, beside the hospital system.
